title: The Bargain Pit
text: A ring of smooth stone round a pit that breathes warm air, in and out, slow as a sleeper. Coins glitter on the lip where someone lost their nerve. Carved on the rim, in a hand like a child's: anything thrown in comes back as something better.

options.label: Throw a purse of gold into its breath, and trust the carving tells the truth.

outcomes.text: It returns on a warm gust, heavier than before. The coins are slick and faintly warm, as if they had been held in a mouth.
It does not come back. Far below, something swallows and breathes a little easier.

options.label: The hardiest bleeds into the pit, offering more than gold.

outcomes.text: The pit returns something into their veins that was not there before, strong and hot and not entirely theirs.

options.label: Roll a stone over its mouth. No good comes from a hole that breathes.

outcomes.text: The breathing stops. Somewhere a long way down, something is bitterly disappointed.
